$comment: Contributions to OTHER PEOPLE's software. A category of its own, because it is a different kind of evidence than an own repo: not 'I built something', but 'others took my work into theirs'.
foundVia: Zenodo search by author name. WARNING: this search is not an enumeration — it finds neither TanabeSugano nor SpectraFit, whose metadata carries the name differently. Further contributions may exist and be missing here.

contributions.what: ORCA External Tools — interfaces to external programs for the quantum chemistry package ORCA.
contributions.whyItCounts: ORCA is an established quantum chemistry package. A contribution there is evidence of a different kind than an own repo with the same star count.
